description: This file defines types, functions, and constants for interacting with the Mattermost API, including client creation, user/channel fetching, posting messages, uploading files, and retry logic for creating direct channels.

methods.name: normalizeMattermostBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a raw base URL by trimming and removing trailing segments like /api/v4.

methods.name: buildMattermostApiUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL from the base URL and a specific path.

methods.name: readMattermostError
methods.description: Reads and extracts error message content from a Response object.

methods.name: createMattermostClient
methods.description: Creates a Mattermost API client with request handling and optional SSRF guard.

methods.name: fetchMattermostMe
methods.description: Fetches the current authenticated user's info.

methods.name: fetchMattermostUser
methods.description: Fetches a user by user ID.

methods.name: fetchMattermostChannel
methods.description: Fetches a channel by channel ID.

methods.name: fetchMattermostChannelByName
methods.description: Fetches a channel by team ID and channel name.

methods.name: sendMattermostTyping
methods.description: Sends a typing indicator to a channel.

methods.name: createMattermostDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct message channel with specified user IDs.

methods.name: createMattermostDirectChannelWithRetry
methods.description: Creates a DM channel with retry logic for transient errors.

methods.name: createMattermostPost
methods.description: Posts a message to a channel.

methods.name: uploadMattermostFile
methods.description: Uploads a file to a channel.
